title: Membership in the edge language
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits, and let $n,i,j$ be natural numbers. The encoding of the unary string of length $n$ paired with the encodings of $i$ and $j$ belongs to the edge language of $C$ if and only if vertex $i$ is an argument of the gate at vertex $j$ in the $n$-input circuit, with $j$ a gate vertex.
